page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.xlarge is a local-storage-equipped virtual instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor based on the x86_64 architecture, configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs spanning 2 physical cores at 2.5 GHz with Hyper-Threading enabled. The system includes 33 MB of L3 cache, support for AVX-512 vector extensions, and AES cryptography instructions. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of memory, resulting in an 8.0 GB per core ratio, alongside a bundled 959 GB local SSD. It does not include hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

Benchmark results show modest baseline performance across computational and memory operations. In single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, it recorded 1101.89 and 2923.84 points respectively, ranking in the bottom 25%. Geekbench yields 941.0 in single-core and 2049.0 in multi-core metrics, with text processing and gzip compression testing in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth ranges from 20.18 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads to 18.64 GB/sec for writes. The baseline network speed is capped at 2 Gbps.

The qualitative trade-off of this instance lies in the integration of dedicated local SSD capacity with a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8:1, balanced against legacy CPU processing speed. While static web serving throughput (2.52 GB/sec) and database benchmark operations (1081.7 PassMark score) reflect low computational throughput relative to modern standards, the included 959 GB SSD eliminates peripheral disk-attach overhead for low-latency scratch storage. It is suitable for caching nodes, small local database instances, and batch ETL pipelines requiring moderate memory capacity and fast disk access over heavy compute power.
